def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Get environmental parameters
    ground_top = sandbox.get_ground_y_top()
    x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max = sandbox.get_build_zone()
    span_left, span_right = sandbox.get_span_bounds()

    # Main beam parameters
    beam_width = 4.0
    beam_height = 0.2
    beam_y = 2.0
    beam_density = 0.05

    # Vertical support parameters
    support_width = 0.1
    support_height = beam_y - ground_top
    support_y_center = ground_top + support_height / 2
    support_density = 0.05

    # Add main beams (span from x=6.0 to x=14.0)
    beam_a = sandbox.add_beam(x=8.0, y=beam_y, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=beam_density)
    beam_b = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.0, y=beam_y, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=beam_density)

    # Add vertical supports
    support_left = sandbox.add_beam(x=6.0, y=support_y_center, width=support_width, height=support_height, density=support_density)
    support_right = sandbox.add_beam(x=14.0, y=support_y_center, width=support_width, height=support_height, density=support_density)
    support_center = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=support_y_center, width=support_width, height=support_height, density=support_density)

    # Connect supports to ground with pivot joints
    sandbox.add_joint(support_left, None, (6.0, ground_top), type='pivot')
    sandbox.add_joint(support_right, None, (14.0, ground_top), type='pivot')
    sandbox.add_joint(support_center, None, (10.0, ground_top), type='pivot')

    # Connect supports to main beams with pivot joints
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_a, support_left, (6.0, beam_y), type='pivot')  # left end of beam_a
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_b, support_right, (14.0, beam_y), type='pivot')  # right end of beam_b
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_a, support_center, (10.0, beam_y), type='pivot')  # right end of beam_a
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_b, support_center, (10.0, beam_y), type='pivot')  # left end of beam_b

    # Add central pivot between beams (for extra stability if needed)
    sandbox.add_joint(beam_a, beam_b, (10.0, beam_y), type='pivot')

    return beam_a
